title: MoveObjectPayload
description: A FULLY RESOLVED translation. delta_meters is an explicit world-space offset in canonical meters; there is no unit field and no direction field, so unresolved language such as '50 cm', 'right', or 'toward the window' is structurally unrepresentable here. Semantic resolution happens earlier (packages/spatial, then the agent) and must be complete before a job exists. additionalProperties:false is what enforces the absence of leftover language fields.
